items.note: Published (scheduled run, two workers; first Proverbs article: work title 'Enarratio in Proverbia Salomonis regis Israel', PDF = printed page + 22). Text lost at the foot of p. 16 (PDF 38) left column, after 'Psalmista : Sicut oves', marked […] (Ps 48:15 noted): check the scan. Margin readings corrected with notes: '1 Reg. xii, 3' (Ididia) → 2 Kings 12:25; 'Par. xxii' → 1 Par 22:9; 'Joann. v… 20' → John 10:20; 'I Cor. iv, 18' → 2 Cor 4:17-18; 'Ps. lxxii, 27' → Ps 72:19; 'Posuit in lacum vitam meam' (beside Jer 51:34) is Lam 3:53 (ref-only). Chapter-only margins given verses (Prov 3:18, 22:18, 29:5; Ecclus 6:35; Matt 15:14-15). Margins missing their book on p37/p39 read from the text (Job 21:14, Is 30:10, Ps 14:4, Ps 26:13, Is 64:4, 1 Cor 2:9, Is 32:17-18). Tagged without margin note: Matt 6:9, Ps 140:5, Job 18:10, Jer 30:11, Prov 28:1. Douay-Rheims slip: Acts 20:27 'spread' for 'spared'.

Published (scheduled run, worker). The cut left the article's last line on p45 ('infusa, pro salute æterna … accendimur'); added. A '[…]' after 'ignavia,' (p45) kept; the sense runs on, probably nothing lost. Margin readings corrected with notes: 'Exod. xv, 14' → Ex 20:14; 's. xi, 2' → Is 11:2; 'id. iii, 9' → Is 3:9; 'Joann. ii' → 1 John 2:11. Denis reads 'hereditabunt' at Matt 5:4 (noted). Douay-Rheims slip: Prov 2:7 'He wilt keep'.

Published (scheduled run, two workers). The cut had put the end of Art. III (v. 35: 'tur. Unde in Ecclesiastico … Superbi gloria cito fit ignominia', p56 right column) into proverbs-004; moved here. Margin readings corrected or supplied (cut-off margins), with notes: Osee 8:12, Is 50:10, Osee 13:9, 2 Cor 3:5, Phil 2:13, Is 49:10, Apoc 7:16, Mal 3:10-11, Agg 1:9-10, Ps 80:13, Job 38:8, Job 36:29-31, Ps 118:103, Ps 50:8, Gal 5:20, Gen 2:10; 'cordium inspector' given as 1 Kings 16:7 / Prov 24:12 / Ecclus 23:28 (guesses, noted); Elias's words are 3 Kings 18:15 (margin 3 Kings 17:1, 4 Kings 3:14). v. 3 quotations have no margin notes; tagged where Denis names the source. Is 26:19 'ros dulcis *': the edition's footnote is not in the transcription. Douay-Rheims slip: Prov 3:3 'mercy aud truth' (shows in the article until fixed).

Published (scheduled run, worker). Margin readings corrected with notes: 'I Par. viii, 9, 10' → 1 Par 28:9-10; 'Ibid. viii, 7' → John 8:47; 'Joann. vi, 4' → John 6:64; 'Ps. cxviii, 33' → Ps 118:133; 'Cor. xiv, 3' → 1 Cor 14:38; 'Amos v, 1[…]' → Amos 5:12; 'I Reg. vii' → 2 Kings 7:14 (Denis's wording is 1 Par 22:10). v. 27 'manifeste malum est, omnino abstinere' seems to lack a 'non' (noted; check the scan). 'natura ligni' (v. 16 paragraph) looks corrupt, left out of the English. Tagged without margin note: Ps 82:14, Jer 4:1, 1 Cor 14:40.

Published (scheduled run, worker). Margin 'Jer. x' does not fit: the words are Jer 23:24 (noted). Psalm number of the margin for 'Iniquitates meæ supergressæ' unreadable: Ps 37:5 marked (noted). Ps 48:13/21: v. 21 quoted, v. 13 ref-only. Denis reads 'Ipse iniquus morietur' at v. 23 (noted). Cyril's 'Proverbs' glossed as probably the Speculum sapientiae (uncertain). Douay-Rheims slip: Is 12:3 'Thou shall draw'.

Published (scheduled run, two workers, split at v. 16). '[…]' in the first line ('de diligentia […] circa fidejussionem', PDF 65): check the scan. Margin readings corrected with notes: 'Ecclus. xxix, 20' → Ecclus 29:19 (DR numbering); 'Philip. 12' → Phil 2:12 (ref-only); 'Is. lvi' → Is 56:10; 'Ps. lxxxviii, 12' → Ps 78:12; 'Ezech. xvi' → Ezech 16:52 (ref-only, loose). Range margins (Ex 22:1–4, 7–13; Deut 22:22–25; Jer 3:1–13; Ezech 16:15–34) given ref-only markers to their first verse. Denis's readings noted: v. 5 'de insidiis aucupis', v. 15 'morte improvisa' in italics, v. 31 italics run past the Vulgate.

Published (scheduled run, worker). Title completed from the right-column heading on p72 ('FILI MI, CUSTODI SERMONES MEOS'). Bible data: Prov 7:1 in both data/bible/drc and the Vulgate file stops at 'Son,' / 'Fili,' (missing 'honour the Lord, and thou shalt be strong: and besides him fear no other'); that half of the lemma is plain English for now. Margin 'Is. ii, 12' → Is 51:12 (noted). Tagged without margin note: 1 Kings 2:30, 2 Mach 15:2, Ps 143:1, Ps 48:15, Matt 16:18. The printed '*victimam' (likely an edition footnote) left out.

Published (scheduled run, two workers, split at v. 22). The print's verse numbers run one verse out from v. 28 on; tagged by the text. Denis skips v. 16. Readings noted: v. 4 lemma adds 'ut convertamini et salvemini'; v. 13 'in quantum servilis, dicitur vulnerare' obscure (translated literally, '[so the print]'); v. 19 gloss has 'auro obrizo'; Osee 13:11 'et principes in indignatione mea'; 1 Tim 6:19 'thesaurum bonum'. 'Injustitia mortis est acquisitio' (beside Sap. i, 16) is not in the Douay-Rheims: left unmarked with a note. Margin 'Ps. cm, 31' read as Ps 103:31; 'Dan. vii, 9 … 13, 22' marked at 7:9. Tagged without margin note: Job 40:14, John 1:18, John 1:1. Possible misprint 'irrationabilibus ac animatis' (inanimatis?) kept.

Published (scheduled run, worker). Denis's gloss on the Vulgate addition after v. 18 ('Qui enim applicabitur illi…', not in the Douay-Rheims) is its own untagged last paragraph, with a note. Matt 26:27 margin given as ref-only (consecration words are 26:28, noted). Readings noted: John 4:34 'of my Father'; v. 16 'Quis est parvulus?'; 1 John 5:10 'the Father'.

Published (scheduled run, worker). The article file was cut short at 'perver-sa_, i' (end of v. 32 gloss); completed from transcribed/p93.txt. Margin numerals corrected with notes: Ps 83:18→82:18, 'Ps. x, 3 sec. Hebr.'→Ps 9:24, Ps 111:4→140:4, Ps 86:6→76:6, Is 11:24→40:24, 1 Thess 1:9→2 Thess 1:9. Ps 21:27: Denis has 'Nomina' where the Vulgate has 'corda' (printed footnote missing): only 'shall live for ever and ever' marked, with a note. Bible data slip: John 6:45 in data/bible/drc reads 'cometh forth me' (should be 'cometh to me').

Published (scheduled run, worker). Is 66:2 quoted in an older Latin form (no margin note): reference-only marker with a note; Is 24:18 ('Cf.') reference-only. Col 3:13 margin: last words are Eph 4:32's, marked so with a note. v. 10 'exaltabitur' (margin variant 'exsultabit') noted. Range margins (Acts 12; Job 1 with Tob 1–2; 1 Kings 28; Job 32–37) given reference-only markers with the full margin reading in a note. Repeated transcription lines (around Luke 19:13 / Matt 25:21 and 1 Kings 28) dropped.

Published (scheduled run, worker). 'Qui suavis est…' (end of v. 11 in the Vulgate, start of v. 12 in the Douay-Rheims) tagged 12:12; Denis reads 'in moderationibus, in suis monitionibus' (noted). Other readings noted: v. 12 monumentum, v. 23 versutus, v. 27; Is 57:17, 1 Cor 7:14, Is 50:4. 'Num. v, 19, 22, 21' as ref-only markers. 1 Thess 4:17 kept (Vulgate file has it at 4:18). Tagged without margin note: Job 36:13, Jer 4:2, Wis 6:26, Is 50:4, Is 32:7, Matt 5:9, Zach 6:13, 2 Cor 7:10, Ecclus 30:24–25, Job 1:1, 2 Tim 3:13; Jas 1:2 ref-only. Stories of Joab, Absalom, Saul, Naboth have no margin note, so no marker.

Published (scheduled run, worker). Margin 'Ps. lxxi, 6' does not fit: the words are Ps 62:6 (noted). Ecclus 29:28 (Vulgate) marked 29:27 (Douay-Rheims numbering, noted). Tagged without margin note: Jas 3:2. Variants noted: v. 2 impiorum; John 14:21 ostendam; 1 Pet 1:8 videntes; Seneca 'pauca'. v. 1 'Tales fuerunt Audiunt…' seems to lack a word (Latin kept as printed). Douay-Rheims slip: Prov 13:2 'month' for 'mouth'.

Published (scheduled run, worker). v. 9: Denis reads 'Stultis illudit peccatum' (ref-only lemma marker, noted). Readings noted at vv. 23, 26, 28 ('neque ordinatos', perhaps 'atque'). Margin 'Joann. iv, 1' → 1 John 4:1. Tagged without margin note: Luke 13:5. Loose quotations ref-only: Tob 3:22, Prov 2:14, Ps 57:11, Hab 2:4/Rom 1:17. Wis 7:30 inverted and Jer 34:16 'holy' noted. Ranges given by first verse: 1 Kings 25:18, Dan 13:45.

Published (scheduled run, two workers, split at v. 18). Margin 'Ps. xxvii, 1' → Ps 26:1; 'Matth. xviii, 20' → Matt 8:20 (noted); Job 14:2 note belongs to the clause before the Anna sentence. v. 14 'quærit' (margin correction of 'quæret'). Ranges at first verse: 1 Kings 25:24, Judg 8:2, 1 Mach 16:15, 2 Kings 13:27. Readings noted: v. 9 'vita impii', Rom 12:2, Jer 17:9, Matt 5:7, Mich 7:9 'Deducet', Deut 25:16 'impietatem'. Many obvious quotations tagged without margin note (Ps 33:16–17, Ezech 9:9, Soph 1:12, Ps 72:11, Ps 93:8–9, Prov 28:9, Gen 4:4–5, Ps 5:7, Ps 10:8, Ps 138:8, Ps 85:13, Gen 37:35, Ps 145:9, Deut 10:18, 1 Tim 5:3, Ps 147:3, Is 60:18, Is 1:16, Mich 2:1, Heb 4:12, Matt 17:5, Mark 16:20). Margin numeral for v. 31 missing. Kept 'digna in cathedra' (dignus?).

Published (scheduled run, worker). v. 11: the transcription has 'Lapides sæculi … pro Saeculi, positum Sæculi … in saeculo'; the lemma keeps 'sæculi', but Denis's explanation of the copyists' error was corrected to 'Lapides sacculi', 'pro Sacculi', 'in sacculo' (check the print). v. 1: 'reliquasque virtutum quas amiserunt' translated as the virtues they did not lose, with a note. Margins corrected with notes: Ecclus xxiii, 23 → Ecclus 18:23; Ps xxxvii, 3 → Ps 27:3; 'Cf. Joel ii, 23' marked though closer to Deut 11:14. Denis's readings noted: v. 13 'dirigetur', v. 14 'nuntius … placabit eum', Job 21:30 'in diem malum'.

Published (scheduled run, worker). Margins corrected with notes: Jer xvii, 20 → Jer 18:20; 'Sap. iii' → Wis 3:6; bare 'v. 14' → Eccles 10:14; 2 Cor 1:14 kept ref-only (wording closer to 1 Thess 2:20). Latin slips corrected: v. 13 'recordet' → 'recedet', 'excusef' → 'excuset'. v. 28 printed '…in corde stulti. reputabitur. Intelligens.' kept as printed, with a note. Denis's readings noted: v. 19 'os suum', v. 17 'Deum et proximum', Ecclus 19:12 'femori canis', v. 6 margin variant 'alias participes'.

Published (scheduled run, worker). v. 1 Denis prints execrabilis (margin variant exprobrabilis), noted. Gen 19:7–9 quoted loosely: 19:7 reference-only, 19:9 marked in part. Bernard passage: Ps 26:3 and Gal 5:17 reference-only. Luke 14:11 marked with 18:14 in a note; Matt 5:32 / 19:9 reference-only. Ps 132:1 tagged without margin note (Denis names the Psalmist). Several of Denis's readings differing from the Vulgate noted.

Published (scheduled run, two workers). Art. XIX treats chapters 19 AND 20 (no separate heading for ch. 20; the next article is numbered XXI): published under both chapters. Its last lines (20:30, 'do æquanimiter toleretur … vigent in homine.', top of PDF 159 right column) had been cut into proverbs-021.txt and were taken from there. 20:5 transcription garbled ('igno- * sed tum est'), read as 'ignotum est aliis; sed homo sapiens'. III Esdr. 3:18–24 (not in the DR) given as a note. Douay-Rheims data slip: Lev 24:20 reads 'eye for ere'.

Published (scheduled run, worker). proverbs-021.txt also held ch. 22 (Art. XXII, heading missing: now proverbs-022) and, inside v. 1, the end of the 20:30 gloss (lines 24–42, used by Art. XIX). v. 15 'amari[…]tudo' kept, translated 'bitterness' with a note. Margin 'Cf. Ibid. xxxiii, 33' → Ecclus 3:33 (ref-only, noted). Readings kept with notes: exors (v. 6), sapientiam (v. 11), judicium (v. 21), victorias (v. 28), superare (2 Par 25:8). Tagged without margin note: Mich 6:7–8, Job 24:7, Prov 19:25, Luke 6:30, Prov 19:5, Is 46:10, Jer 49:19, Job 23:13, Ps 32:17, 2 Par 25:8.

Published (scheduled run, worker). The printed heading is missing from the transcription (running heads p165–168 say ART. XXII): title supplied in brackets from v. 1, with an article note; please take the real title from the scan (PDF 164/165). Text from proverbs-021.txt (ch. 22) and the first lines of proverbs-023.txt (22:28–29). Margins corrected with notes: 'Jacob. ii, 3' → Jas 2:5; 'Ps. lxxx, 3' → Ps 80:13; 'Ps. x, 14 sec. Hebr.' → Ps 9:35; 'Ibid. lxv, 0' → Is 65:20 (ref-only). Denis's readings noted: superbi (v. 5), Fili mi (v. 17), ostendam (v. 19), v. 27, 1 Pet 3:15 'fide et spe', Ecclus 41:15.

Published (scheduled run, worker). The article file's first lines (22:28–29) belong to Art. XXII and were moved there. Margins corrected with notes: 'Eccli. xxii, 6' → Ecclus 32:6; 'Ps. x, 14' (Hebrew) → Ps 9:35. Tagged without margin note: Ecclus 31:23, 31:38. Conjectural corrections: 'præinducatur' → 'præinductam', 'præteactas' → 'præteritas'. v. 35 'et* non dolui' (margin '* sed') kept with a note. Bible data slip: Rom 13:12 in data/bible/drc reads 'passed And the day'.

Published (scheduled run, worker). Garbled asterisks in the transcription kept in t with notes (v. 15 'iniquitatem * in * impietatem'; end remark '* ibi Tamen quod dicitur hic *'): check against the scan. Margin Prov. xxviii, 26 does not fit (28:23 marked, noted); II Reg. xxiii, 5 kept as printed though it hardly fits. Job 33:29–30 and Prov 6:9 tagged without margin notes (Denis names them).

Published (scheduled run, worker). Title partly lost in the transcription ('QUAS TRANSTUL[…]TI … […]LERUNT VIRI'), filled as 'HÆ QUOQUE PARABOLÆ SALOMONIS, QUAS TRANSTULERUNT VIRI, ETC.': check against the scan. Range margins (Luke 14:8–11, Luke 1:46–55) marked at first verse.

Published (scheduled run, worker). Last line ('frequenter sequuntur … inferni supplicia', PDF 188 right column) taken from proverbs-027.txt line 16. v. 6 transcribed 'iniquitatem habens' read as 'bibens' (Vulgate; Denis's gloss 'potare'): check the scan. Margin 'Prov. xxviii, 8' at v. 22 is 18:8 (noted). '[…]' after 'libidinosum' (v. 28) dropped as a lost margin note. DR data slip: Prov 26:23 'earthern'.

Published (scheduled run, worker). A stray line in proverbs-027.txt (line 16, 'frequenter sequuntur facta injusta et opera vitiosa, sicque loquentem praecipitat ad inferni supplicia.') is the end of Art. XXVI (26:28, after '…quia ex verbis quae profert,'): left out here. v. 13 transcription garbled ('pro quibus * aufer ei spopondit, aufer pignus ab eo *'), read as 'pro quibus spopondit, aufer pignus ab eo': check the scan. Margin variant at v. 8 ('irreformatione') and a margin summary left out. Denis's readings noted: osculantis (v. 6), evacuet (v. 16), concitati spiritus (v. 4), dulcibus (v. 9). Ecclus 29:28–30 ref-only at 29:28 (DR/Vulgate numbering out of step there).

Published (scheduled run, worker). End of the article (vv. 25 end–28, PDF 198 right column) taken from proverbs-029.txt lines 7–8. Margin 'Ibid. xxx, 23' at v. 14 is Job 31:23 (noted). Ezech 45:9 'separate eorum vestra' kept as printed (garbled; Vulgate confinia vestra).

Published (scheduled run, worker). v. 1 joined across a column break ('dura cervice cordis | impatienter se habet'); the sentence seems short by a word ('contemnit'?): check the scan. '[…]' at v. 27 dropped (sense runs on). 'Gloria patris, filius sapiens' (v. 17) not in the Vulgate: left unmarked with a note.

Published (scheduled run, two workers). DOUAY-RHEIMS DATA BUG: data/bible/drc/proverbs.json has v. 29's text under 30:19 and 30:29 empty, so the lemmata of 30:19 and 30:29 are plain English without markers; once the Bible file is fixed they should get markers. Also 30:22 reads 'when be is filled'. Kept as printed with notes: investigabiliter, alii destituti, instituisset; 'hericiaciis' (Ps 103:18) probably garbled. 'Ps. lxvi, 5' read as Ps 56:5, 'Is. iii … 13' as Is 3:15 (noted).

Published (scheduled run, two workers, split at v. 13). Chapter-only margins (Matt. xiii, xx, xxiv; Apoc. v, xix, xxi) given as verse 1, ref-only, with a note. 'Non legatum, non angelum misit' (Is 63:9 in the old/Septuagint reading) left untagged with a note. Margin 'Is. liii, 14' → Is 52:14 (note). Margin ⟦31⟧ stands beside 'Mulier timens Dominum' (v. 30); tagged 31:30. Tagged without margin note: Luke 6:12, Matt 19:28, Ps 44:17. 2 Thess 3:10: printed asterisk with margin 'vult operari' explained in a note. Lev 19:15 and Gen 18:19 quoted loosely: only the matching words marked.
Published (scheduled run, one worker). Margin 'Prov. viii, 4' → Prov 7:4 (note); 'Matth. xix, 20' → Matt 19:21 ref-only (note). Heb 2:4 in Denis's order; 2 Tim 3:17 Denis omits 'Dei'.

Published (scheduled run, worker). v. 21 printed 'spiritualiter*' with margin variant 'specialiter' (noted; stray 'ter' dropped). John 1:16 tagged without margin note. 120 virgins: note pointing to Acts 1:14–15. Trailing '[…]' after 'Amen.' are end-of-book blanks.

Published (scheduled run, two workers, split at v. 7; first Ecclesiastes article: work title 'Enarratio in librum Ecclesiastæ', PDF = printed page + 22). Margin 'Job xxxiv, 21' → Job 34:24 (note). Prov 15:20 / 10:1 loose: ref-only with note. Jerome's 'et non miremur' looks corrupt (translated as 'non meruimus', noted). Note on 'Vapor fumi et aura tenuis' (Jerome, from Aquila/Symmachus/Theodotion) is the worker's recollection: worth a check. v. 18: Denis reads 'addit et dolorem' (DR 'labour'), noted. 2 Thess 2:10 as the margin gives (the Vulgate file numbers it 2:11). 3 Kings 4:29–34 given as 4:29 with a note. Tagged without margin note: Eccles 12:13.

Published with one gap: at the column break on p. 223 (PDF 245), after 'Et quamvis non possit suo Crea-' the right column begins 'per Isaiam testatur': a line or more seems lost; marked […] with a note on the likely sense. Please check PDF 245 against the scan. 'tædium me vitæ meæ' read as 'tæduit' (Vulgate 2:17). Margin 'Ps. liii, 6' → Ps 52:6; 'Jon. iv, 3' → Jon 4:8 (Denis's wording), both noted. 2 Cor 6:14: Denis has 'conventio' (noted). Prov 21:17: Denis 'non erit sapiens' (noted). Margin Jos xiii–xxi given as Jos 13:1.

Published (scheduled run, one worker). Margin '11' beside 'Deus docet nos super jumenta' read as Job 35:11 (note). Is 26:17-18 in Denis's division (note). Rom 12:15 tagged for 'flere cum flentibus' only (note: the Apostle has 'rejoice'). Tagged without margin note: Luke 12:4, Luke 6:21, Job 8:21, 1 Cor 7:3, 7:5, Matt 15:13, Deut 32:39, Gal 2:20, Col 3:3, Job 5:17-18, Prov 4:23, Joel 2:13, Ps 50:6, Eccles 2:11, Gen 3:19, Matt 10:39, Ps 15:10, Acts 13:36, Apoc 10:6, John 7:6, 2:4, Job 23:10, Ps 65:10, Acts 23:8. Latin 'persecutaretur' (v. 18 gloss) read as 'perscrutaretur' by the sense: check the scan.

Published (scheduled run, one worker). Hab 1:13 in Denis's wording ('conculcante' for 'devorante', note); Hab 1:3 ref-only. 'si natus non esset' tagged Matt 26:24, Mark 14:21 ref-only (note). Is 9:6 quoted as 'Puer natus est nobis' (note). From v. 10 on no margin notes in the transcription; tagged where Denis names the source: Ps 132:1, Ps 104:20-21, Wis 10:14, Job 36:7-12 (in part, note), Amos 6:1, Soph 1:9, Is 9:6, John 8:44; Ezech 28:17 ref-only.

Published (scheduled run, one worker). The pre-cut article stopped mid-word ('permodicum reputant in-'); its last lines ('…tuitu et amore retributionis futuræ … ante faciem Dei?', with margins Phil 1:23, Ps 119:5, Ps 41:3) stood at the head of ecclesiastes-006.txt and were added here. Margin 'Ps. cxi, 4' → Ps 140:4; 'Ps. xciv, 3' words are Ps 46:3 (both marked, note); Luke 18:24–25 as the margin gives, though Denis's 'regnum cœlorum' is Matt 19:23–24 (note); Hab 1:3 ref-only, 1:13 marked (note). Tagged without margin note: Ps 75:6.

Published (scheduled run, one worker). Its pre-cut file began with the last lines of Art. V (moved there). Margin 'Is. xxxiii, 11' → Is 27:11 (note); Is 47:13 quoted freely (note). 'De hoc ego pronuntio' kept as printed (Vulgate 'ergo').

Published (scheduled run, two workers). Art. VII treats chapter 7 and 8:1 (Denis ends the chapter with 'Sapientia hominis lucet in vultu ejus'): published under both chapters, the 8:1 part under ch. 8 before Art. VIII. Margin 'Eccli. xi, 22, 23' → Ecclus 3:22–23; 'Ps. cvii, 24' → Ps 103:24; 'Prov. xxii, 4' → Prov 23:4; 'Ps. cxxviii, 6' → Ps 138:6; 'Ps. cxviii, 9' → Ps 117:9 (each with a note). v. 18: 'Omnia… sed non singula, vitare valemus' looks reversed; translated by the usual teaching, with a note. Douay-Rheims data slip: John 6:45 reads 'cometh forth me' (should be 'cometh to me').

Published (scheduled run, one worker). Art. VIII treats 8:2–17 and 9:1 ('Omnia hæc tractavi in corde meo'): published under both chapters, the 9:1 part under ch. 9. Margin 'Job xxiv, … 36, 37' read as Job 34:7, 34:36 (note). Jer 8:15 / 14:19 and Hab 1:3, 13 quoted freely (notes). The transcriber's note at the end placed v. 17, Rom 11:33–34 and Jer 23:18; followed.

Published (scheduled run, two workers). One word ending lost in the transcription at v. 10 ('prosequ[…]re', surely 'prosequere'): kept as […]. Margin 'I Joann. iii, 24' → 1 John 4:13 and 'Ibid. iv, 6' → 1 John 5:19; 'Mach. iii, 19' only loosely matches 1 Mach 3:19 (reference only); Prov 20:9 quoted in an older Latin form; Osee 'Quia oblitus es mei, obliviscar et ego tui' matches no verse word for word (Osee 4:6, reference only) — each with a note. The closing question on whether one can know one has charity is tagged v. 1.

Published (scheduled run, one worker). Printed footnote correction 'manuum' used at v. 18. Margin 'Cf. Prov. xxii, 12' not Denis's wording (reference only, note); Ecclus 27:29 quoted loosely (note); Gen 3:1, 4, 13, 14 reference only. Denis's variant readings of 10:1, 10:5, 10:11, 10:19 ('bibentes') noted.
The article's last lines (from 'distinctæ partes ætatis' to 'pro eodem sumuntur', p. 283 right column) had been cut into ecclesiastes-012.txt; joined back here.
Editor's Vulgate readings beside asterisks (eum*, conteratur*, imminuto numero*, Quando*) given as bracketed notes; margin 'Ps. cxi, 3' taken as Ps 140:3.

Published (scheduled run, one worker for Art. I and II; first Canticle article: work title 'Enarratio in Canticum canticorum Salomonis', filed under chapter 1). Prologue article: untagged except the two paragraphs (Bernard, Gregory) on in whose person 1:1 is spoken. Transcription repeated 'sit de latere Christi dormientis in cruce' (kept once).
Published (scheduled run, with Art. I). Prologue article, filed under chapter 1 with no verse tags. Matt 22:12–13 and Ex 19:12–13 reference only; Heb 12:20 quoted.

Published (scheduled run, two workers): chapter 1, vv. 1–6 up to Deut 33:12 'inter humeros illius requiescet' (the lines moved from part 2's file). Margin 'Ps. lxxxiii, 12' → Ps 73:12 (ref only, note); 'Ps. i, 8' → Ps 50:8 (note); Acts 13:47 / Is 49:6 split (note); Matt 5:12 with Luke 6:23 wording (note). Douay-Rheims data slip: Cant 1:3 reads 'the rightous love thee'.
Douay-Rheims slip in data/bible/drc: Cant 1:14 reads 'Behold thou are fair' (twice; should be 'art'), quoted as it stands.
Margin '48. 11.' beside 'Creator Salvatorque' fits no verse: given as Is 43:11 with a note (guess). Douay-Rheims slips in data/bible/drc: Cant 1:3 'rightous', 1:14 'thou are fair'.

Published (scheduled run, one worker). Garbled repeats in the transcription (near v. 3 and the Coloss. 2:3 line) kept once. Latin corrections worth a glance: 'cum oculo sancto recipere' → 'osculo'; 'quo summus redemptus' → 'quo sumus redempti'.
